caption: The drawing depicts a single carved object, predominantly brown in color, centered on a light beige background with a faint rectangular border. The object features a prominent bust of a man with detailed facial features, curly hair, and a high-collared jacket. The top of the object showcases carved elements resembling oak leaves and acorns, while the sides present symmetrical, flowing patterns. The bottom of the object includes the word "WASHINGTON" in raised, capital letters. At the bottom center of the page, outside the border, the name "Carl Keksi" is printed in light, small font. The carving appears textured and three-dimensional, with shadows emphasizing the intricate details.
title: Pipe Bowl
